title: Grandpa Played the Same Lottery Numbers for 41 Years. Then We Found This…
hook: Grandpa played the SAME lottery numbers for 41 years… never won
story: My grandpa played the exact same lottery numbers every single week for forty-one years. He never won anything. Not even five dollars. My dad called it the dumbest habit in the family. When grandpa passed, we found a shoebox under his bed, full of old tickets. Thousands of them. But halfway down the box, the tickets stopped… and turned into bank deposit slips. Same day every week. Same amount. Starting the week I was born. On top was an envelope with my name on it. The note inside said: "These numbers were never lucky. They're the dates I almost lost everything. The day I got sober. The day your grandma said yes. The day your dad was born early and nearly didn't make it. When you were born, I realized I'd already won. So I stopped buying tickets, and started buying your future." Eighteen years of five dollars a week, plus interest. That's how I paid for my first year of college. And that's why, every single week now… I play the exact same numbers.
description:
The most expensive habit in our family turned out to be the best one. ❤️
